shared_elements: low relief carving on a rough stone slab
row of rounded, dome-like forms in a line
an incised framing line following the slab edge
justification: The most specific correspondence is the pairing of a wide diamond-hatched net band with an adjacent row of evenly spaced rounded dome-like forms, plus a shared registered layout inside an edge-following frame on a monolithic slab. The decisive difference is that A is densely figurative — recognisable quadrupeds, birds, a scorpion and a snake rendered in modelled naturalistic relief — while B is almost wholly abstract geometry in shallow, flat, schematic carving on a differently shaped (rounded-topped) stone.
